name: Ultimate Product Table for WooCommerce
author: Plugincy

sections.description:
Ultimate Product Table for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce store into a highly customizable, fast-loading, and conversion-optimized product display system.

Create beautiful product tables, comparison charts, grids, and lists with a simple drag-and-drop builder. Perfect for wholesale stores, B2B marketplaces, product catalogs, or any store needing faster product browsing and bulk add-to-cart functionality — all without writing a single line of code.

🌟 Overview

This plugin provides the ultimate flexibility in how you present your products. With six powerful layout types, 40+ customizable product elements, advanced filtering, and AJAX-powered interactivity, you can build stunning tables that enhance usability and boost conversions.

Whether you want a compact data table for technical products or a modern grid for lifestyle items, Ultimate Product Table for WooCommerce adapts to your needs.

» Buy Pro | » More info | » Demos | » Docs

🏗️ Key Features

🧱 Visual Table Builder

  • Drag-and-drop columns and elements with live preview.
  • Add, remove, reorder, and duplicate elements easily.
  • Real-time design updates with undo/redo support.

📊 Six Layout Types

  1. Table Layout – Classic multi-column layout with sorting, sticky headers, and responsive stacking.
  2. Comparison Layout – Compare multiple products side-by-side with highlighted differences.
  3. Grid Layout – Modern, card-style grid display with hover effects and equal-height cards.
  4. List Layout – Clean, row-based layout with detailed product information.
  5. Masonry Layout (Coming Soon) – Pinterest-style layout for dynamic height tiles.
  6. Slider Layout (Coming Soon) – Carousel-based layout with autoplay and swipe support.

🧩 40+ Product Elements

Display detailed product data including:
– Title, image, price (regular/sale/savings)
– Ratings and reviews
– SKU, ID, attributes, and categories
– Stock status, quantity, progress bars, and backorder messages
– Add to cart, quick view, compare, and wishlist buttons
– Vendor info (Dokan, WCFM, WC Vendors compatible)
– Social share buttons and QR codes
– Custom text, meta fields, and shortcodes

🔍 Advanced Query System

  • Filter by category, tag, product ID, or custom meta.
  • Show on-sale, featured, or in-stock products only.
  • Sort by title, price, rating, popularity, or custom order.
  • Display unlimited tables with unique product sets.

🎨 Complete Design Customization

  • Control colors, typography, spacing, borders, and hover effects.
  • Sticky headers, zebra stripes, compact/comfortable modes.
  • Responsive column visibility and alignment.
  • Pre-designed templates: Minimal, Modern, Classic, Premium, and more.

🔄 AJAX & Interactive Features

  • AJAX Add to Cart without page reloads.
  • AJAX pagination, filtering, and sorting.
  • Infinite scroll or load more options.
  • Bulk add-to-cart and checkbox selection.
  • Quick view popup and lightbox support.

🔌 Integrations & Compatibility

  • ✅ WooCommerce 8.0+
  • ✅ Multi-vendor plugins: Dokan, WCFM, WC Vendors
  • ✅ Wishlist plugins: YITH WooCommerce Wishlist
  • ✅ Page Builders: Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Oxygen
  • ✅ Schema & SEO Ready
  • ✅ GDPR, RTL, and mobile friendly

🎯 Why Choose This Plugin

  • Visual Drag-and-Drop Builder – Create product tables instantly with live preview.
  • 6 Layout Types – Table, Comparison, Grid, List, Masonry (coming soon), and Slider (coming soon).
  • 40+ Elements – Display images, prices, attributes, stock, ratings, and more.
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight, fast, AJAX-powered, and SEO-friendly.
  • Unlimited Tables – Build different product tables for pages, categories, or use-cases.
  • No Coding Required – Customize everything visually from your WordPress dashboard.

🧠 Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need coding knowledge?

No, the plugin is completely visual and beginner-friendly. Build tables easily using the drag-and-drop interface.

Can I use this with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works perfectly with any well-coded WordPress or WooCommerce theme.

Can I create multiple tables?

Yes, you can create unlimited product tables for different pages, categories, or custom queries.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports variable products with variation selectors.

Can customers bulk add to cart?

Yes, checkbox selection allows adding multiple products to the cart in one click.

Is the plugin SEO optimized?

Yes, the output uses semantic HTML5, schema markup, and optimized loading for Core Web Vitals.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes, all tables are shortcode-based and work seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and more.

Does it support RTL and multilingual sites?

Yes, the plugin supports RTL languages and is translation-ready with a .pot file included.

Support

For support, feature requests or bug reports, please visit Plugincy Support.

Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Ultimate Product Table for WooCommerce”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to Ultimate Table in the admin menu to create your first product table.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin to start using it.

Usage

  1. Go to Ultimate Table → Add New Table.
  2. Choose a layout (Table, Grid, List, or Comparison).
  3. Add columns and elements via drag-and-drop.
  4. Configure query, filters, and design settings.
  5. Save and copy the generated shortcode, e.g. [wcproducttab_table id="123"].
  6. Paste it into any post, page, or widget.

Shortcode Reference

Basic Shortcode:
[wcproducttab_table id=”123″]

With Parameters:
[wcproducttab_table id=”123″ per_page=”20″ orderby=”price” order=”asc”]

Available attributes:
– id — Table ID (required)
– layout — table | grid | list | comparison
– category — category slug
– tag — tag slug
– per_page — products per page
– show_header — true/false
– show_footer — true/false
